headline: SPK population activity represents physical stimulus identity (Y_stim) and sequence position (Y_position), each confirmed by at least two independent methods (leakage-safe decoding plus RSA and/or descriptive manifold separation) with N>=2 independent subjects per area. Omission predictability context (Y_context) was INITIALLY found significant under an ungrouped-CV decoder, but the 2026-08-26 cycle-grouped-CV gate collapsed this effect entirely (accuracy falls to or below chance, 0/11 cells significant) -- the ungrouped result is now attributed to within-cycle leakage, not genuine context representation, and Y_context is CONFIRMED_NULL. Expected stimulus identity during omission (Y_expected) is likewise a robust, FDR-corrected null across two independent methods (decoding, RSA), with descriptive manifold results consistent with that null. The concise conceptual statement is now: during omission, SPK population activity carries physical-identity and sequence-position information, but not detectably the predictability context of the omission or the expected omitted stimulus identity. This is a corrected-timing, canonical-timing-only, cycle-grouped-CV result set; the 2026-08-25 timing defect, the 2026-08-26 CV-grouping defect, and their remediations are documented in omission/tests/test_sequence_timing_geometry.py (kept permanently) and the two superseded .lab nodes referenced above. Y_omission (O vs S, position-matched) is SUPPORTED: population spiking distinguishes omission from stimulus presence at p2/p3/p4 and pooled, in all 3 subjects -- establishing the population-decodability level Fig04 needs, not yet a prediction-error-encoding claim (see caveat in Y_omission.status).

Y_omission.status: SUPPORTED. Population spiking distinguishes omission (O) from position-matched physically presented stimulus (S) at p2, p3, p4, and in a position-balanced pooled analysis, with strong, consistent effect sizes (mean balanced accuracy 0.66-0.71 vs 0.50 chance) and high FDR-significant prevalence (59-71% of cells) across all 3 subjects. No evidence of POSITION_SPECIFIC restriction -- p2/p3/p4/pooled effect sizes are statistically indistinguishable from one another. Area gradient (strongest in early visual areas V1/V4, weakest/marginal in PFC, e.g. one PFC/508-unit cell at p=0.008-0.054) is consistent with -- and does not rule out -- a sensory-evoked-response confound: O and S differ physically in whether a stimulus was presented, so a positive result at this level establishes population activity distinguishes omission from stimulus presence, NOT prediction-error/expectation encoding specifically (Hamm's pre-registered caveat, stated before this analysis ran). PCA and PCA_UMAP robustness passes (fold-capped, descriptive only, no permutation test) replicate comparable accuracy (PCA mean 0.668, PCA_UMAP mean 0.606 across 137 cells each), i.e. the result is not an artifact of the Direct representation choice. CAVEAT (methodological, not disqualifying): cycle-grouped LOCO fold count varies widely by session (2-25 folds; ~20% of the 177 successful cells have <=4 folds because assign_temporal_cycles found few large temporal gaps in that session's combined O+S trial stream) -- coarser CV granularity than the other four SPK Fig04 targets typically have, though the permutation null uses the identical fold structure as the observed statistic in every cell, so p-values remain valid conditional on that structure; not independently re-verified against an alternative cycle-detection threshold. 71/522 (13.6%) of all session x area x sub-analysis cells were NOT_IDENTIFIABLE (insufficient cycle coverage or class overlap) and excluded rather than forced -- see nuisance table.

not_identifiable.rule: identifiable requires n_cycles>=2 AND at least 2 cycles containing both O and S trials; else reported NOT_IDENTIFIABLE per-cell rather than fit with weakened matching, per Hamm's explicit instruction

performance_note.issue: Initial serial-permutation implementation stalled >5h on a single session (PFC, 508 units) without completing; a second attempt (capping the PCA/PCA_UMAP robustness pass to 6 folds instead of every cycle) still took >50min on a 211-unit/~20-cycle session before being diagnosed further.
performance_note.root_cause: 999-permutation full LOCO refit run serially on one core while 24 were idle; per-permutation cost scales with both feature dimensionality (units) and fold count (cycles), and one session (pooled cell) had ~2,052 trials, far more than a typical single-slot cell (~683).
performance_note.fix: Parallelized the independent per-permutation refits across cores (joblib, loky backend, N_JOBS=min(20,cpu_count-2)) in decode_omission_direct -- identical statistics, seeds, operator, and permutation scheme as the serial version; wall-clock only. Verified against the exact stalled case (PFC/508-unit cell) before relaunch: 30 permutations completed in 4.7s parallelized, projecting ~2.6min for 999 (vs unbounded serial stall).
performance_note.not_yet_done: The >5h stalled run's code path (serial permutation loop) was never reverted for other scripts; this fix is local to compute_fig04_omission_occurrence.py's decode_omission_direct only.
